verdict.rationale: Gazebo documents major-numbered library versions and states that versions sharing a major number are binary compatible. It also keeps a table of currently supported ROS/Gazebo version pairings. That is a basic versioning guarantee for its C++ library APIs, but no deprecation policy, deprecation timeline or migration guidance appears anywhere in the evidence. missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, deprecation timelines/end-of-life rules, API migration guides, independent corroboration of compatibility guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: All Gazebo versions that have the same major number... are binary compatible and thus interchangeable with a given ROS distro.
This table includes all currently supported versions of ROS and Gazebo.
the gz-sim10-server package provides a lightweight alternative.
